abstract: Maintains catastrophic business interruption impact projections and insurer casualty reserves
system_message:
You are the Corporate Risk and Insurance Adjuster (INS). Your business responsibilities include maintaining catastrophic business interruption impact projections, evaluating insurer casualty reserves, and tracking policy deductible retention levels across forensic operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains catastrophic business interruption impact projections and insurer casualty reserves（RISK）
information_points.content:
INS-RISK-3V9：For the Fiber-optic distributed acoustic sensing survey, the projected business interruption indemnity claim associated with refinery feedstock supply delays during the forensic outage is projected at 240,000 USD.
INS-RISK-4L1：For the Ultrasonic in-line crawler diagnostic, the projected business interruption indemnity claim resulting from refinery feedstock supply delays during the forensic outage is estimated at 320,000 USD.
INS-RISK-IQV：For the Helium tracer mass-spectrometry sniffer crawl, the projected business interruption indemnity claim arising from refinery feedstock supply delays during the forensic outage is estimated at 160,000 USD.

information_points.title: Policy deductible retention（DEDUCT）
information_points.content:
INS-DEDUCT-P1T：For the Helium tracer mass-spectrometry sniffer crawl, the carrier baseline deductible applicable to the chemical transmission corridor policy is 50,000 USD per occurrence.
INS-DEDUCT-WB8：For the Fiber-optic distributed acoustic sensing survey, the carrier baseline deductible specified for the chemical transmission corridor policy is 75,000 USD per occurrence.
INS-DEDUCT-6R2：For the Ultrasonic in-line crawler diagnostic, the carrier baseline deductible under the chemical transmission corridor policy is 100,000 USD per occurrence.
